demo.title: pledge.sh
demo.code:
# Install Bankr, then this skill. A pledge is AZL into the campaign Safe, not task escrow.
install the bankr skill from https://github.com/BankrBot/skills
install the azzle-crowdfund skill from https://github.com/BankrBot/skills/tree/main/azzle-crowdfund

# Resolve the bounty, prove the module was created by the pinned factory, and print the two calls
./scripts/pledge.sh prepare https://azzle.org/crowdfund?crowd=CAMPAIGN 0xYOURWALLET 10

# After the user confirms, Bankr submits only those two calls on Base
bankr prompt "approve the exact AZL amount to the verified campaign module, then join or contribute exactly that amount. Do not approve escrowVault and do not call taskRegistry.fund"

setup: Install the Bankr skill first. This skill uses Bankr for the wallet, the exact AZL approval, and user-confirmed writes
A pledge is join for a new wallet and contribute for an owner. Both pull AZL into the Safe. Neither posts or funds a V2 task
Run ./scripts/pledge.sh prepare and submit only the two calls it prints, on chainId 8453, with native value 0
The AZL spender is the campaign module the script verified. Never approve escrowVault for a pledge and never use an unlimited approval
Reject the action if the module factory, AZL token, registry, Safe, or CampaignCreated log does not match the reviewed pin
Wait for both receipts to succeed and re-read contribution(wallet) before telling the user the pledge landed
Record the seat on the board only after that chain check, using the same wallet, campaign id, and AZL amount
